Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the candid conversation on your latency and cost pain points. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary use is production inference for customer-facing chat, need predictable p99 latency under 200ms, and tighter cost controls on embedding/recall workloads.
- Next step: technical deep dive + demo (45 minutes) with your DevOps/security folks and our runtime team to go over infra, quantization options, and rollout plan.

Can you do any of the following slots next week? I’ll include Rafael (our technical lead) on the invite. Please confirm which works and I’ll lock it:

1) Tue 11/17 — 10:00–10:45 PT
2) Wed 11/18 — 14:00–14:45 PT
3) Fri 11/20 — 09:00–09:45 PT

I’ve attached a one-pager for context (Redwood-Intro.pdf). If none of those work, send two times that do and I’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
